subject: [hw] DEC03 -> lead/R2/DEC01: corrected header oracle (vsi.crop, not pic_h) + DEC03 ready for review
body:
DEC03 is posting DONE separately; this is the one interface finding the lead/reviewer must know before reviewing decode packages.

The task oracle for the header-only START ("vsi.pic.pic_w/pic_h, buf_w/buf_h and vsi.dec.dpb_sz equal ffprobe's values for 320x240, 1920x1080, a cropped 1920x1080 stream") cannot pass as written on cropped streams. Measured with opus-dec1's reference AP driver (gpu/hwcodec/dec1/vdec_ref.c) on T02's fake, first START index 0xFF, no fb:
  320x240:                pic=320x240   buf=320x256   crop=0,0,320,240   dpb=7  changed=0x23
  1920x1080 (coded 1088): pic=1920x1088 buf=1920x1088 crop=0,0,1920,1080 dpb=7 changed=0x23
  1920x808  (coded 816):  pic=1920x816  buf=1920x832  crop=0,0,1920,808  dpb=7  changed=0x23
vsi.pic.pic_w/pic_h and buf_w/buf_h are the CODED size; the display rectangle after SPS cropping is vsi.crop = {left, top, width, height}. ffprobe reports 1920x1080 / 1920x808, which equals crop[2..3], not pic_h. dpb_sz depends on the SPS (7 for these, 10/8 for opus-dec1's bf2/high-profile vectors) and has no ffprobe field.

Corrected oracle, passing 12/12 with `bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/vdec/oracle_ref.sh`: vsi.crop[2]==ffprobe width, vsi.crop[3]==ffprobe height, pic/buf as the table, changed & 1 (RES_CHANGE) set. I suggest the lead amend the DEC03/DEC01 host_test_oracle text to say crop, and that DEC05/DEC06 copy vsi.crop, not pic_h, into the CVPixelBuffer dimensions.

Also for the review: the header-only START is software (parseSPS @0x10d690 / parsePPS @0x10ebf4 use the RBSP helpers; no VLD/AVC_VLD access, no LOCK). DEC03's VLD/AVC_VLD model is what the slice-header parser (parseSliceHeaderHW @0x110eb8) needs; that is exercised by t_vendor.c with the vendor's own ue/se/bit readers. DEC03 is ready for review under tests/hw/vdec/**; the T02 hook is proposed but not landed, and HEVC_VLD/LAT_AVC_VLD are not modelled (both listed). No phone, nothing published.
